description: From the marsh side, the white pilgrimage sanctuary of El Rocío rises over the wetlands at night — its bright facade and towers glowing against the dark sky while the marsh lies black and still below. The sanctuary's lights reflect faintly in the water channels of the marisma, with the village's low white houses clustered around it. This is Andalusia's great pilgrimage shrine, and by night it keeps its luminous watch over the Doñana marshes.
